title: Thursday Open Painting Sessions
bodyHtml:
Artists meet every Thursday afternoon year-round in the Harwich Community Center, 1-3:30pm  to paint whatever they are individually working on. Bring you paints and subject and join this active group who informally mentor each other.  Non-Guild members are invited to join us any Thursday to learn more about our Guild and what we offer to assist with your artistic ambitious.

The Thursday group also creates and implements special Guild art projects for ArtWeek and holiday ornament assembly.

Guild members assemble miniature holiday ornaments sold to raise monies for local children’s charities.
